hooks.name: kiro-dir-never-ignored
hooks.description: UNVERIFIED FORMAT: replace with the file Kiro writes when this hook is recreated in the Agent Hooks UI (docs/KIRO_SETUP.md step 0). Kiroween rule: .kiro must never be gitignored. After the agent edits a .gitignore, fail if git would ignore any .kiro path. --no-index is required: without it, git skips ignore rules for tracked files and the check never fires.

action.command: if git check-ignore -q --no-index .kiro || git check-ignore -q --no-index .kiro/steering/product.md || git check-ignore -q --no-index .kiro/hooks/compliance-guard.json || git check-ignore -q --no-index .kiro/specs/ride-ingest/tasks.md; then echo 'COMPLIANCE: .kiro is now gitignored. Revert that .gitignore change immediately (Kiroween disqualifier).' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo 'compliance ok: .kiro not ignored'

hooks.name: license-must-exist
hooks.description: UNVERIFIED FORMAT (see above). Kiroween rule: an OSI license must stay at the repo root. Fail if the agent deletes LICENSE.

action.command: test -f LICENSE || { echo 'COMPLIANCE: LICENSE was deleted. Restore it now with: git checkout -- LICENSE' >&2; exit 1; }
